title: Add automated stress test to a model to see if the configurations are good
summary: It can be hard to configure a certain model on given hardware, and stress testing it in production is a tedious and frustrating process. We should have a command that allow you to stress test a model and report: - any fails (e.g. OOMs) - Latency for calls based on X concurent user (e.g. 1, 2, 4, 8, 16) ... - anything else useful? The report should be in the command line and in a log file. example: ./anvil stress

title: [CraftSim] Window anchoring is incredibly frustrating since rework
summary: **Describe the bug** Ever since you reworked the addon window positions anchor relative to the center of the frame and because of this there is no position where you can place any of the windows that STAYS anchored to the edge of the craft window when swapping between the regular craft frame and the work order frame. This is happening because there's now one singular widget between work order crafting and regular crafting. **To Reproduce** Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Position a window (eg. recipe info or reagent optimization) 2. Go to work orders and click a patron order 3. Note that while the craft window grows in size in this view, the frames remain exactly where they were relative to the center of the frame 4. Readjust windows to fit again 5. Go back to regular crafting and not that the windows are once again out of place. **Expected behavior** The windows to behave like they did before with separate layout positions for regular crafting and work order crafting, or failing that to offset the left or right placement by the difference in window size **Screenshots** Initial position After swapping to a patron order After fixing the position for patron orders And back to regular crafting **Addon Version:** 27.0.1
